quests.title: Brook the Carnivore

dialogue.sit: Do you need some Raw Meat?

dialogue.t: Oh, you must have seen that commission of mine.
Well, do you have six servings of Raw Meat with you?
Oh my, these cuts are very good indeed.
Thank you very much for your help. Here's a little something in return.
Come over when I'm done with my research — you'll be the first to try my new dish, I promise.

quests.description: Springvale’s Brook requires six servings of Raw Meat.
